parsed.doc_summary: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb 2017): applies to housing providers receiving DND funding/land or with BPDA inclusionary income-restricted units; limits criminal-history and credit-score screening and requires case-by-case review.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.requirement: In housing funded by or on land from Boston DND, or with income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy, providers may not use blanket bans on applicants with arrests or convictions and may not consider non-conviction arrests, expunged/sealed convictions, juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old (with exceptions for direct relationship/unreasonable risk). Credit scores may not be used to approve or deny applications.
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb. 2017)
citation_aliases: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.quoted_span: will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis.
rules.key_value: No blanket criminal-history bans; no look-back beyond 5 years for convictions; no credit score use
rules.effective_date_note: Policy document dated February 2017; exact effective date not stated.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.
rules.exemptions: Does not apply where a conviction has a direct relationship to the housing sought or poses unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or to current criminal behavior; conflicting federal or state law preempts.
rules.interaction: Federal or state criminal-history requirements that conflict preempt this policy.

requires_unknown_facts: property receives City (DND) funding or land, or has income-restricted units under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy
